source: Official trophy descriptions as handed out with the competition starter

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy on this list. The platinum unlocks on its own once the other 54 are yours, so follow the roadmap: play the story first, sweep the missables while you are there, then clean up activities and collectibles. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game and only happens once in a playthrough, so it is flagged missable — it unlocks naturally as you start the story. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through to the end of Chapter 1. A one-time story beat, flagged missable; it comes automatically if you finish the chapter. Source: official description.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Story trophy tied to a one-time chapter ending, flagged missable. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Story trophy tied to a one-time chapter ending, flagged missable. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Story trophy tied to a one-time chapter ending, flagged missable. Source: official description.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story. The finale only happens once per playthrough, so this gold is flagged missable — there is no way back to it after the credits except a new game or chapter replay. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Play and finish the story mission Breakfast Run when it appears. A one-time story mission, flagged missable. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Play and finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. A one-time story mission, flagged missable. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Play and finish the story mission Child's Play. A one-time story mission, flagged missable. Source: official description.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Play and finish the story mission Headliners. A one-time story mission, flagged missable. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Play and finish the story mission VCIA Takedown at the airport. A one-time story mission, flagged missable. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Play and finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. A one-time story mission, flagged missable. Source: official description.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The long haul: finish the story, every activity type, the collectibles and the side strands until the completion counter reads 100%. Use the tracker to sweep up the last stragglers. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts. Stunt jumps, near misses and airtime all count — string them together while driving between missions and 250 adds up fast across a full playthrough. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once. Sample one of everything — races, fishing, the arcade, the shooting range, drone races, bowling, meditation, hunting and one more — and the trophy pops. Source: official description.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Work through each range challenge until every one shows a gold medal; the range keeps your best medal per challenge. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Learn each course's line, then win at every spot. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts — work through the race list across Leonida until 20 distinct wins are on the board. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Find Cal at a fishing spot and out-fish him in the challenge. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Pick any arcade cabinet and finish a full game. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's last mission when it appears. His story strand ends here, so it is flagged missable — a one-time story beat. Source: official description.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's last mission. A one-time story beat, flagged missable. Source: official description.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's last mission. A one-time story beat, flagged missable. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands. Pick up stranger missions as you explore Leonida and see eight strands through to the end. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's last mission. A one-time story beat, flagged missable. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's last mission. A one-time story beat, flagged missable. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots. Find every meditation spot across the map and sit through a session at each. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Track down the unique animal Bret asks for and hunt it. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — gather full sets; three complete sets pops the trophy. Source: official description.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The WAiNK It spots are all over the map — hit a hundred of them. Source: official description.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish 50 challenges. Challenges stack up across everything you do; 50 completions unlocks it. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: During a partner story moment, build a 4-star wanted level, then break line of sight together and escape. It happens in a one-time story context, so it is flagged missable. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Chain three shop robberies with your partner in one run while keeping your wanted level. It happens in a one-time story context, so it is flagged missable. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or encounter a hundred distinct vehicles — variety counts, so try everything from scooters to trucks. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in one Combat Focus. Group enemies up, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five before it ends. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave VCIA in an unscheduled way. This is a one-time story beat at the airport, so it is flagged missable. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with Rhino tanks. Take on the Rhinos — heavy weapons and good cover help. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being seen. Go in quiet: no alarms, no witnesses. Plan the approach and the exit. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Five vault jobs, five clean getaways. Source: official description.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Hit an armored truck on the road, grab the cash and break away before backup arrives. Source: official description.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Cover the whole map — every named area counts once you have set foot in it. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation of each of the 9 gangs. Nine gangs, nine operations. Source: official description.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find the spot, order the drink and take in the view. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. This is a one-time story moment in a showroom, so it is flagged missable. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a full game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Follow through at the alley — a complete game counts. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal. A one-time story beat with your partner, so it is flagged missable. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices across the story. The counter tracks decisions — keep deciding and it climbs toward 500. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Fail once, then succeed on the second try at the same thing. Source: official description.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange out in Leonida. Keep your eyes open off the beaten path. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by — a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills. Feed marked bills to your contacts until a quarter of a million is clean. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in shops. Vehicles, clothes, weapons and more all add up. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Source: official description.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Save vehicles into the app until ten are registered. Source: official description.
